主要内容: On February 4, 2021, Shira Goodman informed Henry Schein, Inc. of her intention not to seek reelection to the board of directors at the 2021 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. She will continue to serve as a director and on the Nominating and Governance Committee and Strategic Advisory Committee until the Annual Meeting concludes. Paul Brons will also retire from the board following the Annual Meeting, in accordance with the company’s director retirement policy, which requires directors to retire at age 80. Additionally, on February 9, 2021, the board appointed Mohamad Ali and Deborah Derby to fill two new board positions, effective immediately, following the expansion of the board from fifteen to seventeen members.
